name: Questscape
detailed_description:
Welcome to Questscape and your first case: "Escape from Cell 13" - Your ultimate Escape Room Escape Simulator!

Immerse yourself in the world of the first-person puzzle game, experienced solo or in online co-op mode. "Questcape - Escape from Cell 13" promises a gripping adventure with interactive puzzles. Here are some exciting features awaiting you:
Interactive puzzles in every corner:

Plunge into rooms full of challenging puzzles that will test your skills.
Find clues, crack codes, and reveal secrets to escape from Cell 13 and the prison.

Online Co-op Mode:
Two heads are better than one! Play all rooms in online co-op mode and team up with a friend to tackle tricky challenges together. Can you escape within the 60-minute time limit per section?
Features:

Logical thinking is essential: Solve puzzles based on intelligent thinking, waiting for you in every room.
Explore different rooms: Search the prison, find hidden clues and objects to pave your way to freedom.

Background Story:
You and your friend (if playing in co-op mode) are wrongly imprisoned, finding yourselves in the notorious Cell 13 of a high-security prison. Thanks to a security system glitch, the guards are distracted, giving you exactly 60 minutes per section to plan your escape.

Chapter 1 - Cell Breakout:
In the first part, you must escape from your cell before the guards return and thwart your escape. The prison's locking system works during this time, but at least you won't be observed. Despite the absence of guards, breaking out of your sealed cell is anything but easy. Use your intelligence, find clues, and work as a team to successfully complete the first section.

Are you ready for the ultimate Escape Room experience? "Escape from Cell 13" is waiting to be explored and mastered by you. Beat the clock and prove you have what it takes to break free!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10-capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Some community-made rooms are quite big and performance heavy and need more RAM memory and better GPU.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
